name: omnipix-desktop
description: OmniPix menu-bar app — local OpenAI-compatible LLM router

scripts.build:all: npm run bundle:server && npm run build:main && npm run build:preload
scripts.dev: npm run build:all && npm run rebuild:native && electron .
scripts.dist: npm run build:all && npm run rebuild:native && npm run stage:client && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run build:all && npm run rebuild:native && npm run stage:client && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:all && npm run rebuild:native && npm run stage:client && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:store: npm run build:all && npm run rebuild:native && npm run stage:client && electron-builder --win appx --x64 -c.directories.buildResources=store-assets -c.directories.output=dist-store --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:all && npm run rebuild:native && npm run stage:client && electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never
